summary.zh: 摄像头既能发现你，也能成为你看见敌人的眼睛。
summary.en: A camera can expose you—or become your own lookout.

rules.zh: 设施监视一片区域，并可能记录证据或触发警戒。玩家选择绕开、破坏或接管，付出工具、资源或绕路成本；接管后的信息收益与清除记录后的补救收益应分开呈现。
rules.en: Security devices watch areas and may record evidence or raise alarms. Bypass, disable or take control at a cost in resources or travel; distinguish new information from the separate benefit of erasing evidence.

loop.en: Locate the device or control point
Use the new safety or information

decisions.zh: 为短暂通过直接破坏摄像头，还是投入更多资源让它持续侦察？
decisions.en: Disable a camera for passage, or invest more to use it for ongoing reconnaissance?

decisions.zh: 已经被录下时，完成目标就走，还是绕去清除记录？
decisions.en: After being recorded, leave with the objective or detour to erase the evidence?

effect.zh: 一个终端控制越多设备，争夺终端越有价值，也越容易成为唯一解。
effect.en: Controlling more devices per terminal raises its value but can make it the only sensible solution.

effect.zh: 成本越高，玩家越要比较情报能否服务于后续路线，而非只看当前房间。
effect.en: Higher costs make players judge the value of information along the whole route.

contrast.zh: 《杀手》强调事后清除证据；《隐形公司》强调把敌方监视能力转为己方视野。
contrast.en: HITMAN emphasizes erasing evidence after exposure; Invisible, Inc. emphasizes converting hostile surveillance into vision.

combination.zh: 设计提案：把接管的摄像头接到条件开关，“有人经过就关灯”，让潜入者设计一小段自动掩护。
combination.en: Design proposal: connect a captured camera to a conditional switch that turns off a lamp when someone passes, creating a small automated cover system.

setup.zh: 摄像头盯着保险柜，远处终端能花两格电量接管它。
setup.en: A camera watches the safe; a distant terminal can capture it for two power units.

action.zh: 你先去终端接管，再用摄像头观察门外守卫。
action.en: Capture it at the terminal, then use its feed to check the guard beyond the door.

result.zh: 保险柜附近不再被敌方监控，你也知道守卫何时离开。
result.en: The safe is no longer under hostile surveillance, and you know when the guard leaves.

next.zh: 保留剩余电量给下一房间，而不是继续接管无关设备。
next.en: Save remaining power for the next room instead of capturing irrelevant devices.

firstStep.zh: 做一台摄像头、一个开关终端与敌方/玩家两种控制状态；同一视野数据切换所有者。
firstStep.en: Build one camera, one terminal and hostile/player ownership; reuse the same visibility data under either owner.

pitfall.zh: 先别做完整黑客小游戏；让控制权变化确实改变玩家能看到什么。
pitfall.en: Avoid a full hacking minigame initially; make ownership visibly change what the player can see.

test.zh: 玩家能否说清接管摄像头带来的新信息，并据此改变下一步路线？
test.en: Can players identify the new information from a captured camera and use it to change their next move?
